title: Detachable handles for a griddle

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I need one detachable handle for both sides. My old handle fits this griddle on the left, but won’t lock on the right.
turns.zh: 我想找一支可拆式把手，兩側都能用。舊把手能裝左邊，但裝右邊時卡扣扣不起來。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: The mounts are mirror images. Your handle locks in one direction. This other handle has a catch you can flip, so it can lock on either side.
turns.zh: 兩側的安裝座互為鏡像。你的把手只能朝一個方向扣上。這一支的卡扣可翻轉，所以兩側都能扣。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Can I flip it while attached? I’d like to move it when I turn the griddle.
turns.zh: 可以裝著把手就翻轉卡扣嗎？我想轉動烤盤時把手換邊。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Set the griddle down first. Remove the handle, then flip the catch and attach it on the other side.
turns.zh: 先把烤盤放下。拆下把手，再翻轉卡扣，把手就能裝到另一側。
